Jefferson County by the numbers

The Census Bureau's 2019-2023 survey counts 777,392 people and 357,923 housing units in Jefferson County, which ranks 1 of 25 ky counties here. Median home value is $237,200, which is 7% above the middle county in this ky set. Households here earn a median $67,849; the middle ky county is at $66,470. 38% of occupied homes are rented, which leaves 62% owner-occupied. The median home was built in 1971, about 52 years ago.
